sizeChart.title: Size guide
sizeChart.intro: Measurements are body measurements in centimetres. If you are between sizes, we recommend the larger size for a relaxed fit.
sizeChart.howToChest: Chest — measure around the fullest part of your chest, keeping the tape horizontal.
sizeChart.howToWaist: Waist — measure around your natural waistline.
sizeChart.howToFoot: Foot — stand on paper, mark heel and longest toe, and measure the distance.
